scientific_decisions.colored_metal: Explicit local-colored only; different trajectory and physical clock, never silently substituted

packaging_verification.kernel_source_hash_equality: All three selected CUDA and both Metal kernels match their original source bytes
packaging_verification.cli: Help, native command dry-runs across CPU/Metal/CUDA, explicit colored selection, full-u64 seed, historical campaign plan, physical-replica plan from existing GPU NPZ, aging estimate-only

packaging_verification.qualification_limit: Original source qualifications are recorded with their original scope. Newly relocated/adapted host executables were not compiled, executed, timed or requalified. H100/L4 runtime qualification is not inferred.

evidence_archive.format: 56 independently readable tar.xz parts with original-path and SHA256 chunk mappings
evidence_archive.exclusions: Explicit hashed exclusions; binaries/caches/locks/transport wrappers and bulk nonbenchmark trajectories are not silently substituted for benchmark evidence
